wiki.title: Goldcrusher
wiki.text:
Goldcrusher is a dwarf enemy NPC that players fight in the Rumbledome, located in Sunstone Valley. He is the champion of the Rumbledome and a Skullz commander whose allegiance is with the Skullz. The Rumbledome announcer states that prior to the battle, Goldcrusher needs no introduction, but some people say that he was born in the Rumbledome itself.
